title: The receive buffer stores bytes in FIFO order without locks
A full buffer rejects new bytes and counts the overrun
The parser resynchronises on the next start-of-frame byte after any error
Frames longer than FRAME_MAX_PAYLOAD are rejected
Frames use CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over length and payload
Received bytes are buffered in the ISR and the comm task is woken
Statistics can be read consistently from any task
